recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-7213 unless OO makes a new decision to simplify this canonical example.
issue_request: FHIR-7213 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO change request for the DSTU1 Observation f202 oral-temperature example. It objected that no one would also populate bodySite 'Entire body as a whole' and method 'Oral temperature taking' if the measurement was already called oral temperature; the accepted resolution was to fix the coding while keeping method because the canonical example intentionally demonstrates resource elements.
initial_application: Historical commit 474be19befc8b8882da2b23a826dd0e2106a1538 appears to have applied the request implicitly: it changed the f202 coding/bodySite context, replacing the bad total-body bodySite with SNOMED CT 74262004 Oral cavity while leaving method in place. The commit subject did not name FHIR-7213.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini and Observation/f202 is listed in source/observation/list-Observation-examples.xml. Related FHIR-7212 explicitly requested the Oral cavity bodySite correction, and FHIR-7232 already has a combined-branch audit for the same bodySite problem. Later vital-signs work moved the methodless LOINC interoperability-standard code back into Observation.code and cleaned stale category wording, explaining the current deliberately verbose code set.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current source has bodySite 74262004 Oral cavity, retains method 89003005 Oral temperature taking, and includes comments indicating that the specific oral-temperature LOINC coding and method can be redundant and are both present for example coverage.
